name: BSP_FrontEndFrame_SelectLayoutSet
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the 0x164 singleton at 00E18D80, two stack arguments (int set, char commit), RET 8 inferred from the call site at 004c9b85 (no caller-side ADD ESP), not read from the epilogue. Holds three parallel handle arrays with matching .rdata name tables: backdrop this+0Ch / names 00E08500 / 13 slots / set stride 34h; panel this+110h / names 00E08604 / 2 slots / set stride 8; title this+138h / names 00E0862C / 2 slots / set stride 8. Returns at once when set equals this+160h. With commit set it first walks all three arrays slot-major and releases every handle belonging to another set (BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate then 00aa31f0 when the word at layout+4h is exactly 1, otherwise InterlockedDecrement(layout+4h) with the layout virtual +0h at zero), then fills the requested set's null slots with BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate then 00aa5840(&name, 1, 1), then stores this+160h = set. Tables: set 0 and 1 FE_frame + FE_frame_title, set 2 adds FE_options_bg (backdrop 6) and FE_main (backdrop 12), set 3 GUI_pause + GUI_pause_title, set 4 empty. GGame::OnInitTitle calls it with (0, 1), so the title bring-up loads exactly FE_frame and FE_frame_title through this path. Four callers: 004c9a70, 004c9ca0, 004dfb70, BSP_LoadingScreen_Begin. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md | Run-time evidence from bsp_game.exe milestone 2c (packet cc_exe_2c), `--frames 120 --press-start-frame 30` against the installed game; see docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md. Set 0 loads exactly FE_frame and FE_frame_title; both stay on screen through the press-start handover because they belong to the 0x164 layout singleton and not to a registry screen. | Packet cc_exe_2j (bsp_game.exe milestone 2j), ABI correction plus run-time evidence. The routine is __thiscall(layouts, int set, int commit), RET 8: the set is [ESP+34h] read at 00518268 and compared with [ECX+160h] at 00518273. At both call sites the two pushes that precede the CALL belong to 00518250, not to 004C1AC0, which takes no arguments and only supplies ECX. The mission load's row at 004E04E4 is therefore (set 3, commit 0) and BSP_Game_ApplyInGameInterface's at 004C9DFB is (set 3, commit 1). In bsp_game.exe the committing call releases sets 0, 1, 2 and 4's backdrop, panel and title layouts and makes 3 active, which takes FE_frame and FE_frame_title off the mission picture; the sprite bridge drops from 70 quads to 57. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2j.
